root_cause: The renderer conformed1280x720 extended footage to1920x1080 before its board crop, but native WTA mask scanning decoded unscaled720p with the1080p search box. FFmpeg silently clamped requestedy826 to nativey566, found part of a board, then the resolver incorrectly added originaly826 to that partial geometry. The old cache key omitted the decode transform.
fix: Render passes explicit per-source conform prefilter and effective dimensions only for sources that actually need scoreboard masks.
WTA applies that exact prefilter before RGB crop/detection. Native and conformed crop bounds are checked against frame dimensions; out-of-frame origins fail instead of allowing FFmpeg clamp.

Cache recipe snapshots exact filter and dimensions, including incremental per-source workers, warm restoration and post-scan verification. Unchanged sources can reuse their own masks when another source transform changes.
Profiles without explicit transform support reject a transformed board scan; existing calls without a transform retain their API and native behavior.

Filter change and effective-dimension change invalidate only the transformed incremental point; same transform hits cache.
A changed filter during detection cannot store under the original key; two runs must rescan and cache manifests remain absent.
Native720p with1080p box and transformed out-of-frame boxes explicitly fail.
Native render adapter passes the correct per-source transformation into mask scanning.
